text:
anya: FYI QA found the Add Model form shifts the primary CTA when field errors appear on narrow viewports. Keyboard covers it too.

sam: Noted. quick options: reserve a slot for errors, absolutely position the message, or move CTA into a sticky footer on mobile.

liam: Sticky footer is more work and can conflict with keyboard. I vote reserve slot + collapse animation. keeps DOM order predictable.

maria: Accessibility: reserve space but use aria-live="polite" for field-level messages so screen readers announce them. For full form submit errors, use aria-live="assertive" at top of the form.

izzy: For required indicators: the asterisk alone fails screen readers. Proposal: visible asterisk + sr-only "Required" preceding label. avoids visual clutter and reads correctly.

sam: Designers worry about wrapping with suffix '(Required)'. sr-only approach seems best. Also show faint helper text area even when empty to reduce perceived layout shift.

anya: What about inline validation timing? Show on blur, but if the user types an obviously invalid pattern (like missing @ in email) show inline immediately. Otherwise wait till blur or submit.

liam: Agrees. Also micro animation (fade/slide) for errors, but respect prefers-reduced-motion. Make sure live region updates immediately, not delayed by animation.

maria: Destructive actions: Repo delete modal currently says "Are you sure?". Security requested typed confirmation for deleting repos with >5GB or with active deployments. Threshold rule?

izzy: Suggested: typed confirm for multi-item deletes, deletes with side-effects (billing, infra), or datasets >5GB. Single small deletions: modal + undo toast.

sam: Regarding paste into typed-confirm input: accessibility recommends allowing paste. If we want friction, require typing the exact repo name rather than a generic word.

liam: Also remember i18n: normalize input server-side (trim, unicode normalization) so comparisons are robust. front-end can live-validate.

anya: Decision summary: 1) reserve error space + micro animation (respect reduced-motion) 2) sr-only "Required" token + visible asterisk 3) field-level aria-live=polite, form-level assertive summary 4) typed-confirm for high-impact deletes (no paste block, server-side normalization). Any objections?

sam: +1

liam: +1

izzy: +1

anya: I'll spin up a small prototype and PR and tag eng/intl/legal. thanks all! :sparkles:

design-bot: Issue created: #3001  forms: mobile error-slot + typed-confirm pattern (assigned to anya)
